title: fix: gateway restart fails from verified external macOS terminals
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes macOS `openclaw gateway restart` failing with “Process ancestry could not be fully inspected” from a terminal that native service membership already verifies is outside the Gateway job.

## User Impact

Verified external terminals can restart the Gateway even when an ancestor cannot be inspected. In-service callers retain detached handoff protection; unknown membership and absent containment retain their existing guards. No config or migration changes. Update/maintenance callers use the same corrected membership owner.

## Why This Change Was Made

The native probe returned `outside`, but its caller still required the ancestor walk to reach PID 1. This redundant requirement was introduced by commit 6209f31ce9bb on September 26 and first appears in release tag v2026.9.7; it is present in the v2026.10.2 tagged source as well as the reported 5b29c85 build. Accept verified outside containment while retaining ancestry checks when containment is absent.

## Evidence

- Added a regression through `restartLaunchAgent`: it fails before the fix with the reported ServiceInspectionError and passes afterward, reaching native kickstart without a detached handoff.
- `pnpm test src/daemon/launchd-service-membership.test.ts src/daemon/launchd-current-service.test.ts src/daemon/service-process-membership.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 99 tests passed, 23.19 seconds Vitest wall time. New regression took milliseconds; no timers or process boots added. CI seconds pending hosted run.
- `pnpm build runtime` passed (1m 19s); production typecheck, targeted lint, formatting and `git diff --check` passed.
- Independent autoreview: no actionable P0–P2 findings.
- `pnpm check:changed` stopped at an inherited stale max-lines baseline for `extensions/amazon-bedrock/index.test.ts`; both that file and its baseline match origin/main exactly. Targeted lint and production types passed separately; `pnpm tsgo:core:test` also passed. Full `pnpm build` was stopped after its unrelated package declaration generation made no visible progress for nine minutes, then the supported runtime build passed.
- Proof uses the native-service boundary harness; the operator’s live Gateway was not restarted.


CI follow-up: the initial head failed `check:test-mock-exports` because the edited membership mock did not preserve real exports. The mock now spreads `importOriginal`, and its obsolete grandfathered baseline entry was removed. The exact mock-export check passes, all six affected tests pass (8.07s Vitest wall time), and formatting, lint, diff checks, and fresh independent review passed. Production code is unchanged by the follow-up.
